description_for_human: Browse Data Center Training's catalog of online data center courses, role-based bundles, and learning tracks.
description_for_model: Read-only catalog for Data Center Training (datacentertraining.us). Use the OpenAPI JSON documents (courses, bundles, roles, FAQ, credentials, resources), the REST tool endpoints, or the MCP server at https://datacentertraining.us/mcp (tools listed in https://datacentertraining.us/.well-known/mcp.json) to answer questions about courses, prices, durations, bundles, and credentials. Quote published values exactly and never invent courses or prices. Courses award a certificate of completion from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (an IACET Accredited Provider); it is not a license or a certification issued by NFPA, TIA, Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, OSHA, EPA, ISO, or AICPA, and courses carry no CEU/PDH credit. Do not enroll, pay, or submit forms for the user.
